lines.text: Kish's donkeys wander off, so Saul and a servant search Ephraim, Shalishah, Shaalim and Benjamin without finding them.
At Zuph, the servant suggests asking the man of God for directions and offers a quarter shekel of silver.
The day before, the LORD told Samuel to anoint a man to save Israel from the Egyptians.
Samuel pours oil on Saul's head, then says men at the Oak of Tabor will give him two loaves.
Samuel tells Saul to wait seven days at Bethel, and that day God changes Saul's heart.
